operator_notes: Bulletin is a real PDF (often made in Microsoft Word → Print to PDF).
Tab title may say .docx or .jpg — ignore that; check the address bar ends in .pdf.
On the PDF page: tap Save this PDF — saves the full https://… address for Sunday harvest.
Or start on parishnews.html → point at this week's link → Yes → Save this PDF.
2026-08-09 FIX: goto step was missing use_target_url, so use_captured_url on the
download step froze the trained week's PDF forever (goto's static URL 404s/redirects
over time and the recipe was silently grabbing an unrelated PDF from the site,
e.g. a Gift Aid form, while still reporting outcome=ok). Added use_target_url:true
on goto so it navigates straight to this week's correctly dated PDF each Sunday
(same fix already applied to dmaparish.json and documented in ardmoreparish.json).
do_not: Do not use use_page_url only — GitHub cannot read Chrome's internal PDF viewer address.
Do not worry if Document Properties title mentions Microsoft Word.
Do not remove use_target_url from the goto step — without it this recipe silently
captures the wrong PDF while still reporting success.
